title: DTECH
bottom_line: ARM, the motorcycle-parts brand, is DTECH's own: its three trademarks are registered to PT DTECH Inovasi Indonesia. The one company DTECH has invested in is a Salatiga maker of Kawasaki Ninja parts called "XYZ"; its president director said so to detik, and it is almost certainly XYZ Racing. Going the other way, Miota and Agung Ventures, both led by Moshe Panjaitan, list DTECH as an acquisition or portfolio company; DTECH has never said so. Its academy sits in a separate foundation, and INKA buys its train seats through its trading arm IMST.

entities.name: DTECH-ENGINEERING
entities.what: Salatiga engineering and manufacturing firm founded 2009: SUPERMILL CNC machines, INKA train seats, ARM motorcycle parts; workshops in Salatiga and Tengaran (Kab. Semarang); Kemenperin directory KBLI 28220.

entities.name: ARM / ARUMI Motoparts
entities.legal_name: PT DTECH Inovasi Indonesia (owner of the ARM ARUMI Moto Parts marks)
entities.what: CNC aluminium motorcycle accessories, started mid-2020 with 3 machines; ~13,500 parts/day; Rp28k-600k; exports to the Philippines, Malaysia and Thailand. No separate legal entity found.

entities.name: DTECH Automation
entities.what: Name DTECH uses for its in-house CNC controller and software ("first made in Indonesia", its claim); no separate company found.

entities.name: XYZ Racing
entities.what: Racing-parts maker (parts for two-stroke bikes such as Kawasaki Ninja R/SS); most likely the "XYZ" Ninja-parts firm DTECH invested in (detikJateng 2024, ~60 staff). Legal name not found.

entities.name: Akademi Inovasi Indonesia (AII)
entities.what: Private D4 academy (manufacturing engineering technology) grown out of DTECH's 2020 Sustainable Education Project; permit SK 181/D/OT/2023 (21 Jul 2023); students paid to design ARM/XYZ parts and INKA seats.

entities.name: Yayasan Inovasi Untuk Indonesia
entities.what: Foundation (yayasan, not a PT) set up in 2022 that runs AII; chair Sumiyanto (Jul 2026).

entities.name: ATWM (Akademi Teknik Wacana Manunggal)
entities.what: Salatiga technical academy where DTECH ran its Sustainable Education Project from 2020 (CNC machines, paid students); same complex as SMK Nusa Persada (2021 report).

entities.name: Yayasan Wacana Manunggal Semarang
entities.what: Foundation named on ATWM's site as ATWM's operator.

entities.name: Yayasan Nusa Persada
entities.what: Foundation behind SMK Nusa Persada; with DTECH it trained vocational graduates in the SEP programme (Dec 2021).

entities.name: SMK Nusa Persada
entities.what: Vocational school; SEP partner with ATWM and DTECH (2021); DTECH opened production in a new practice building in its complex (snippet).

entities.name: SMK Muhammadiyah Salatiga
entities.what: Vocational school that received a CNC machine from DTECH as a grant (hibah) for production work (Sep 2022).

entities.name: SMK Negeri 2 Salatiga
entities.what: Listed as an SEP partner school on DTECH's SEP site (snippet).

entities.name: SMK Saraswati Salatiga
entities.what: SEP partner school with its own production dashboard on DTECH's SEP site (snippet).

entities.name: SMK Negeri 1 Semarang
entities.what: SEP partner school; DTECH's SEP dashboard shows activation 14 Oct 2021, last update 6 Oct 2022 (snippet).

entities.name: SMK Angkasa Husein Sastranegara
entities.what: SEP partner school with a production dashboard on DTECH's SEP site (snippet).

entities.name: PT INKA
entities.what: State rolling-stock maker; orders executive and luxury train seats from DTECH (pilot 2022; 1,400 + 100 seats ordered 2023).

entities.name: PT INKA Multi Solusi (IMS)
entities.what: INKA subsidiary (99.86%), railway-parts trading and construction; parent of IMST and IMSC.

entities.name: PT IMST
entities.what: INKA group trading arm (subsidiary of IMS); issued the 2022 seat pilot order confirmation to DTECH.

entities.name: IMSC
entities.legal_name: PT INKA Multi Solusi Consulting (expansion inferred)
entities.what: Named by AII as a partner on the train-seat project; read as INKA's consulting grandchild company.

entities.name: PT KAI
entities.what: Railway operator; AII calls the seat job "Project 612 KAI"; seats run on New Argo Dwipangga, New Argo Lawu, Taksaka.

entities.name: Politeknik Negeri Madiun
entities.what: State polytechnic in the 11 May 2022 INKA seat MoU; supplies design staff and operators.

entities.name: SMK PGRI 1 Mejayan
entities.what: Vocational school in the 11 May 2022 INKA seat MoU; supplies operators.

entities.name: Miota
entities.what: Jakarta IoT and automation firm (formerly Magnar); says it acquired "DTech Engineer" in 2019 and announced DTECH joining the "Miota family" on 23 Nov 2022.

entities.name: Agung Ventures
entities.what: Venture investor; its own portfolio page lists DTECH-ENGINEERING, Miota and five others; PitchBook (snippet) calls it a minority investor in DTECH.

entities.name: Agung Concern Group
entities.what: Multi-sector group active since 1954 (20+ brands, incl. Agung Toyota); lists Miota under its Investment, Innovation & Technology pillar.

entities.name: Mioto
entities.what: Planned IoT mobility-as-a-service platform; Miota product line, also in Agung Ventures' portfolio.

entities.name: RentalQ
entities.what: B2B online rental platform "from Agung Rent and Miota" (Agung Ventures portfolio).

entities.name: Ritase
entities.what: Logistics and trucking platform; Agung Ventures portfolio sibling of DTECH.

entities.name: Rezka Nayatama
entities.what: Hospitality and agro-tourism project; Agung Ventures portfolio sibling of DTECH.

entities.name: Rajamobil
entities.what: Car-dealer digital platform; Agung Ventures portfolio sibling of DTECH.

entities.name: General Electric (GE)
entities.what: Ran the 2013 3D-printing bracket challenge and the 2017 GE Fuse jet-engine inspection challenge that DTECH won.

entities.name: PT Surveyor Indonesia
entities.what: State inspection firm that certified SUPERMILL at 40.91% local content (TKDN) on 24 Sep 2021.

entities.name: Ditjen Pendidikan Vokasi
entities.what: Vocational-education directorate; under Wikan Sakarinto it promoted DTECH as an internship company (2022).

entities.name: PT Techno Agung Makmur
entities.what: Semarang machine-tool firm ("part of Skipow Group"; TKDN for AGTECH CNCs) whose site sells a "Mesin CNC Supermill" with a "DTECH-AUTOMATION Controller".

entities.name: Solusi Klik
entities.what: Reseller listing SUPERMILL CNC MK 2.0 PRO on the INAPROC government catalogue (snippet).

entities.name: OTC / DAIHEN
entities.what: Welder brand; DTECH lists 50+ OTC/DAIHEN XD350SII welders in its plant.

entities.name: JAL (laser and bending machines)
entities.what: Machine brand; DTECH lists 5+ JAL X7-3015 laser cutters and 5+ JAL JM-3016 benders.

entities.name: General Grinding
entities.what: Grinder brand; DTECH lists 6+ General Grinding M7140A machines.

entities.name: Raycus
entities.what: Fibre-laser brand; DTECH lists 5+ Raycus Fiber 50W laser markers.

entities.name: Shopee
entities.what: Marketplace; ARM store "arumi_moto_parts"; AII says ARM and XYZ are top sellers there.

entities.name: Tokopedia
entities.what: Marketplace; ARM store "arumimotoparts" and an XYZ Racing store.

entities.name: Lazada
entities.what: Marketplace; ARM store "arumi-moto-parts" and XYZ listings.

entities.name: Blibli
entities.what: Marketplace carrying Arumi parts (snippet).

entities.name: TikTok (TikTok Shop / live)
entities.what: Live-selling channel; ARM account @arumi.motoparts (433.5K per DTECH); VP Gibran joined a DTECH live, 7 Nov 2025.

entities.name: Gastipis
entities.what: "Marketplace Sparepart & Aksesoris Motor Orisinil"; first link on ARM's Linktree; lists Arumi and XYZ Racing among its brands. Operator not identified.

entities.name: Nyayur Indonesia
entities.what: Daily-needs shopping app for street vendors and farmers; Fajar Budi Laksono says he founded and ran it 2017-2019.

entities.name: Penggagas.com
entities.what: Online science, technology and startup media; Fajar Budi Laksono says he co-founded and ran it 2014-2017.

entities.name: Arfi'an Fuadi
entities.what: Co-founder (2009) and technology director of DTECH; no other company role found.

entities.name: M. Arie Kurniawan
entities.what: Co-founder of DTECH (2009); current role not public.

entities.name: Fajar Budi Laksono
entities.what: President director (Direktur Utama) of PT DTECH Inovasi Indonesia; operations director in Apr 2024; says he co-founded AII; earlier Nyayur Indonesia and Penggagas.com.

entities.name: Anggi Vandika
entities.what: AII first-batch graduate; president director of the "XYZ" parts firm from Oct 2023; in Nov 2025 working at DTECH, managing ~350 people.

entities.name: Wikan Sakarinto
entities.what: Director of AII; Director General of Vocational Education 8 May 2020 - 1 Jun 2022.

entities.name: Sumiyanto
entities.what: Chair of Yayasan Inovasi untuk Indonesia (Jul 2026); operations director of Yayasan Nusa Persada (Dec 2021).

entities.name: Moshe Panjaitan
entities.what: Founder and CEO of PT Miota Internasional Teknologi; listed as founding managing partner of Agung Ventures (snippet).
